messages:
Talia Gomez: hey folks, first-week onboarding snag. The Grafana iframe embedded in the incident runbook shows "panel not found" while opening the dashboard directly works. The embed url is: https://grafana.redwood.example/d-solo/uid-a1b2/prod-health?orgId=1&panelId=7. Anyone seen this?
Ravi (devex): welcome Talia! :tada: which page are you viewing the embed from (Confluence/playbook/handbook)?
Talia Gomez: it's the incident runbook in Confluence: /display/OBS/Incident+Runbooks. The console shows a 401 on the render endpoint.
Morgan (obs-eng): that sounds like the signed embed token expired or the embed service isn't allowing your SSO session. We rotated embed tokens last week. Are you on VPN and SSO?
Talia Gomez: yes to both. I also noticed the iframe URL has a long query param starting with "sig=" that looks old.
Ravi (devex): okay we'll get infra to look. @DevEx Bot can you open a ticket to add talia@redwood.ai to redwood-observability-embeders and check embed token rotation for the Incident runbook?
DevEx Bot: Created ticket #DX-3471 - "Embed: add talia@redwood.ai to redwood-observability-embeders; investigate expired embed sig on /playbooks/incident-runbooks". Assignee: Ravi. ETA: 6 hours.
Morgan (obs-eng): quick workaround: open the dashboard directly and use Share > direct link to panel or Snapshot for embed screenshots. That avoids signed renders.
Talia Gomez: thanks — workaround works. Two more quick onboarding asks: 1) Datadog CLI returns "403 Forbidden" when I try to create an app key; 2) in Sentry I can't see the org projects (only my personal sandbox). Who owns those perms?
Ravi (devex): Datadog app keys require an application key bound to a user account; creation can be restricted. We'll add Datadog app-key creation to #DX-3471 and request the observability-cli role for you. For Sentry, obs-eng or security usually adds people to org teams.
Morgan (obs-eng): Talia, send me the project slugs or point me to the repos you need access to and Ill map to Sentry teams. For Datadog, Ill request an app key on your behalf; infra may require approval.
Talia Gomez: repos: github.com/redwood/ingest and github.com/redwood/telemetry, so Sentry projects would be ingest-service and telemetry-ingest. Datadog monitors I'll need read access to alerts for those services.
Morgan (obs-eng): noted. I've added Sentry and Datadog requests to #DX-3471. Expect Sentry access in ~2 hours and Datadog app key once infra approves (EOD at latest).
Talia Gomez: awesome, thanks! Appreciate the quick responses.
Ravi (devex): welcome aboard — we'll post status updates to #DX-3471 and close when resolved. If anything else blocks your runbook walkthrough ping me directly. :thumbsup:
